statement: ▶ Conjecture. We conjecture that if one-sided correlation detection in trees fails, i.e. none of the equivalent conditions in Theorem 2, then no polynomial-time algorithm achieves (onesided) partial recovery. In view of Theorem 5 of Section 5 of the full version of the paper [12], which guarantees existence of a non-empty parameter region where one-sided tree detection fails while partial graph alignment can be done in non-polynomial time, our conjecture would imply the hard phase to be non-empty.
